description: LHAPDF sets installed into one shared data directory ($RAVEL_NATIVE_BUILD/share/LHAPDF). Sizes were confirmed against the server on 2026-10-10. 'verified' digests were computed from an independent download. 'single-download' digests come from one download from the CERN LHAPDF server during the 2026-10-10 survey; no second independent source has confirmed them, and the first install compares against them (a mismatch stops the install). To promote one to 'verified', download the set from a second source and record both digests.
